Investigation update: 2026-06-26

Reviewed LPMS error logs for 06.24, 06.25, and 06.26.

Finding: Users are hitting a 500 error when attempting to save/complete an audit. The exception is consistent across all three days:

LPSCAMS.Audit.UpdateAuditStatus: Conversion from type 'DBNull' to type 'String' is not valid.\nat Audit_UpdateAuditStatus.btn_Save_Click() in UpdateAuditStatus.aspx.vb:line 416

A field read at line 416 of UpdateAuditStatus.aspx.vb is returning NULL from the database when it is expected to be a string. This causes a 500 and surfaces to the user as the "Something Unexpected Happened" error screen.

Scope:

Date

Error count

AuditMasterIDs affected

06.24

~40

238, 266

06.25

112

238, 266, 267, 268

06.26

4 (so far)

266

The issue started on 06.24 and has expanded to additional audit masters on 06.25. Multiple stores are affected across each audit master.

Could the LPMS SRE engineer on duty today take a look? The focus would be UpdateAuditStatus.aspx.vb:416 -- identifying which field is nullable and why these audit records are missing the expected value.

Investigation update: 2026-06-26

Additional findings:

  • Confirmed the issue affects the following audit types: Quarterly Audit Systems and Equipment (AuditConfigID 108), FY27 DM OSR (129), and FY27 Store OSR (131).

  • Tested an Alarm Permit Audit and it completed successfully, confirming the issue is not blanket across all audit types.

  • Attempted to reproduce on AuditMasterStoreID=90535 -- error confirmed.

  • The source file (UpdateAuditStatus.aspx.vb) is not tracked in the lpms repo. Engineering will need to access it directly on the server at F:\\IIS\\Clients\\bootbarn\\nettrack\\Audit\\UpdateAuditStatus.aspx.vb to identify the NULL field at line 416.

Environment: Production

Steps to reproduce:

  1. Log in to Boot Barn LPMS: https://apps.lpguys.net/bootbarn/nettrack/?NoSaml=1

  2. Navigate directly to the following audit: https://apps.lpguys.net/bootbarn/nettrack/Audit/AuditWorkbench.aspx?AuditMasterID=238&AuditMasterStoreID=90535&AuditConfigID=108&StoreIdent=981&Mode=0&SetEdit=1

  3. Attempt to change the audit status to Complete and click Save.

Expected: Audit status updates to Complete successfully. Actual: 500 error -- "Something Unexpected Happened" screen is displayed.

Verification -2026-06-26

Reproduced on store 0286, audit 0286-90380 (Quarterly Audit Systems and Equipment, AuditConfigID 108): changing status Scheduled → Completed and clicking Save returns the "Something Unexpected Happened" 500 screen. Still failing.

However, store 0456, audit 0456-90535 (same audit type - the AuditMasterStoreID used in Carlos's repro link) now shows Completed = Yes (06/26/2026); it saved successfully. This explains why Kiran could not reproduce: the failure is data-dependent, consistent with Carlos's root cause (DBNull where a string is expected in Audit_UpdateAuditStatus, UpdateAuditStatus.aspx.vb line 416) - the error only triggers on records where that field is NULL.

Conclusion: the bug is NOT resolved; it persists on affected records (e.g., 0286-90380). Escalating to Engineering.
